name: When should I consider installing a carbon monoxide detector in my bedroom?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider installing a carbon monoxide detector in my bedroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is recommended to install a carbon monoxide (CO) detector in or near every sleeping area, including bedrooms, especially if your home uses fuel-burning appliances such as a furnace, water heater, gas stove, or fireplace. CO is an odorless, colorless gas that can be fatal. If you have an attached garage, a CO detector in the bedroom is also crucial. Modern detectors often combine smoke and CO detection for comprehensive protection. Installing these devices provides an essential layer of safety, alerting you to potential dangers while you sleep.
acceptedAnswer.description: Install a carbon monoxide detector in your bedroom if your home has fuel-burning appliances or an attached garage, as CO is an odorless, deadly gas.
